title: An embedded submanifold that is C^r for every r has C^∞ charts (graph representation over the tangent plane, Simon Ch. 2, 4.4)
statement: C^∞ charts. Data: P, m ∈ ℕ; M ⊆ ℝ^P. Hypothesis: for every r ∈ ℕ, M is an embedded C^r m-dimensional submanifold of ℝ^P (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r m M); the charts may depend on r. Conclusion: every y ∈ M has a C^∞ local representation: there are open sets V ⊆ ℝ^m and W ⊆ ℝ^P with y ∈ W and a map ψ : ℝ^m → ℝ^P that is C^∞ on V (ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ψ V, i.e. of class C^n on V for every n ∈ ℕ), injective on V, with ψ(V) = W ∩ M, V ∩ ψ^{-1}(K) compact for every compact K ⊆ W, and Dψ(z) = fderiv ℝ ψ z injective for every z ∈ V.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)), (∀ r : ℕ, IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r m M) → ∀ y ∈ M, ∃ (V : Set (Euclid m)) (W : Set (Euclid P)) (ψ : Euclid m → Euclid P), IsOpen V ∧ IsOpen W ∧ y ∈ W ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ψ V ∧ InjOn ψ V ∧ ψ '' V = W ∩ M ∧ (∀ K ⊆ W, IsCompact K → IsCompact (V ∩ ψ ⁻¹' K)) ∧ ∀ z ∈ V, Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ z)
